title: The Modest Ones
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:1: “And the modest ones would set down the money.”
In Yoma 39a: “And the modest ones would withdraw their hands.”
In Demai 6:6: “The modest ones of Beit Hillel used to act according to Beit Shammai.”
We likewise find Rabbi Shimon the Modest; see his entry.

notes.text: The supplied Demai abbreviation is ב״מ, while Torat Emet 357 digital Demai 6:6 explicitly has Beit Hillel, supporting that contextual reading. The supplied Yoma verb is מושבין; the William Davidson digital Yoma 39a has מושכין, “withdraw.” Yoma’s quoted passage is Gemara, not a Mishnah at 39a. These sense-based readings do not establish the original printed letters.
